project_name.justification: The authoritative project name is Hat, which is confirmed in the text: 'Doubleview Gold Corp Adds to Its Mineral Claims at the Hat Project'.

company_name.justification: The text identifies the company as 'Doubleview Gold Corp (TSXV: DBG) (OTCQB: DBLVF) (FSE: 1D4)(the "Company or "Doubleview")'.

ceo_buyer.justification: The document is signed 'On behalf of the Board of Directors, Farshad Shirvani, President & Chief Executive Officer'.

interest_acquired_percent.justification: The article describes the staking of new mineral claims, not the acquisition of an interest from another company. The text states: 'The Company has staked nine additional mineral claims at the eastern side of the Hat Project...'

primary_commodity.justification: The project is described as a 'polymetallic porphyry project with major resources of copper, gold, cobalt, and the potential for scandium.' Copper is listed first and is the basis for the Copper Equivalent (CuEq) calculation.

verified_article_link.justification: The article is about the Hat Project as specified. The source URL is provided at the end of the text: 'To view the source version of this press release, please visit https://www.newsfilecorp.com/release/234080'.

currency.justification: The article describes claim staking, not a financial transaction, so no currency is applicable to deal terms. While metal prices for calculations are in US$, no transaction value is given.

cash_payments_raw.justification: The transaction is claim staking, not an acquisition for cash. No cash payment is mentioned in the article.

share_payments_raw.justification: The transaction is claim staking, not an acquisition for shares. No share payment is mentioned in the article.

cash_and_share_payments_combined_raw.justification: The transaction is claim staking, not an acquisition involving a combined payment. No such payment is mentioned.

amount_of_shares_issued.justification: The transaction is claim staking. No shares were issued as part of this event.

share_warrant_payments_raw.justification: No share warrants were mentioned as part of the claim staking.

option_payments_raw.justification: No options were mentioned as part of the claim staking.

issued_share_price.justification: The transaction is claim staking. No shares were issued, so there is no issue price.

exploration_commitment_meters.justification: The text mentions '10,000 metres of additional drilling' as part of a completed 2024 exploration program, not as a future commitment related to an acquisition.

exploration_commitment_value_raw.justification: No monetary exploration commitment is mentioned in the article.

nsr_acquired_percent.justification: The article does not mention any Net Smelter Royalty (NSR) being acquired or retained.

coverage_area_raw.justification: The Company has staked nine additional mineral claims at the eastern side of the Hat Project, bringing the total area claimed to 18,114 hectares.

coverage_area_unit.justification: The Company has staked nine additional mineral claims at the eastern side of the Hat Project, bringing the total area claimed to 18,114 hectares.

resource_size.justification: The resource is detailed in a table and a subsequent sentence: 'In Pit Indicated 150 Mt... Inferred 477 Mt...' and 'The Scandium potential for the Hat Deposit is estimated to be 300 to 500 million tonnes at an average grade of 40 ppm (0.004%) Sc2O3.'

buyer_ticker_and_exchange.justification: The text states the company 'is publicly traded on the TSX-Venture Exchange (TSXV: DBG)'.
